c. 1897, September 27
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 9
Pg. 8 9/27 "Trust not in your own example or presence to keep others - nor to the gravity of your man- ners. It is the grace of God will keep them, whether you are present or not" novitiate
The bee and the ungrateful lie told out of un- reasonable fear. "O God come to my assistance" etc.
Dream about journey to monastery.
Stille Nacht Dec. 24th '96
Temptation & Succor 1/13/'97 + Excelsus 4/4/'97 Summit
